items.title: 52060_Eddie Barefield oral history interview
items.q: We were in Nice in 1976... Dizzy and Illinois and myself and Jackson, Oliver Jackson, all go up to Bud's room.

ctx.x: You know, a little rougher, you know, and Bud Johnson is rougher, but he's -- I'll tell you a story of Illinois Jaquet and Bud. We were in Nice in 1976, and we stayed at the Meridian Hotel, and every night they had a jam session all night long, and everybody congregated there. It was a beautiful year.

And after that we'd mostly go up and hang out in Bud's room, Dizzy and Illinois and myself and Jackson, Oliver Jackson, all go up to Bud's room. You know, I never drank -- I wasn't drinking but joined the rest of them and watch them drink and tell tales.
